plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row of this map, including every printed term total. The 2026-2027 catalog year is taken from the map heading ('Transfer Pathway to CSUB map for 2026-2027') and the program page's 2026-2027 catalog-year selection. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. This extraction did not capture per-course prerequisite flags, so no prereqs are recorded. The program page lists THREE 2026-2027 pathways for this credential. This plan transcribes the FIRST-listed pathway, 'Bakersfield College / History / Associate in Arts for Transfer / 60-63 units / 4 terms / CSU Bakersfield History - Public History Bachelor of Arts / 60 units', Bakersfield College portion ONLY (Terms 1-4, headed 'Transfer Pathway to CSUB' / 'Associate in Arts for Transfer' on the map page). The map page itself shows only the Bakersfield College segment (PROGRAM 1/1); no CSUB courses or terms are listed, so none are transcribed. The second pathway (same Bakersfield College segment to CSU Bakersfield History - Social Science Teaching Bachelor of Arts) and the third pathway (a generic 'to CSU' pattern for the same credential) are not separate degrees and are not collected as separate plans. The map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16.5 / 15 / 15 and a plan total of 60-63 units. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. HIST C1001 and HIST C1002 are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and are recorded with category 'major'. Term 3 prints a single 'CSU Transferable Elective' slot at 5 units, exactly as printed in both views; it is recorded as one 5-unit elective choice slot (code BC-ELEC-3). The 'Major List B - Group 1' and 'Major List B - Group 2' slots are printed with the label 'Major' and are recorded as major choice slots (codes BC-LISTB1-1, BC-LISTB2-1); the two 'Major List A' slots (Terms 3 and 4) are recorded as BC-LISTA-1 and BC-LISTA-2.
